versions.summary: Rebuilt the armored legionary knight as 8 named objects (Head, Body, RightArm, LeftArm, Legs, Spear, Sword, Neck) to match the reference: steel helmet with gold rim and red arched plume, visible face with eyes, brows, nose and mustache, red tassets over a steel cuirass with crossed gold straps, leather belt and front plates, layered pauldrons, red sleeves, gauntlets, greaves and boots, a long spear with crossguard, lathe blade, collar and red ribbon held in the right hand, and a hip sword on the left. Fixed the invalid-position error by moving all tube points and lathe profiles into their part extra fields with proper [x,y,z] positions, and made the part helper always return a well-formed object. Seeded variation from api.random() drives the plume curve and breastplate rivet placement; small details are dropped via lastLevel for LOD.

review.summary: The build reads as a generic armored figure, not the referenced knight. The signature sweeping red plume is wrong in every view (vertical pill-stack from the back, forward hook from the side, single upright capsule from the front). The torso is a barrel/sphere rather than a tapered plate torso, the head is undersized with a bead-face, the red skirt is a thin slab, the feet are detached boxes, and crucially neither weapon is held: the spear and sword float beside the body while the arms hang straight with no gripping hands.
issues: Rebuild the plume as one continuous curved sweep that starts at a helmet crest and arcs backward and downward (reference silhouette); remove the stacked/vertical red ellipsoids and the forward-curved side hook.
Add gauntlet hands and connect the weapons: right hand must intersect/grip the spear shaft at mid-height, left hand must grip the sword hilt at the hip so neither weapon floats free of the body.
Reshape the torso: reduce the ball-like lathe volume, taper the waist, and add a flatter breastplate plus hanging tasset plates so the front reads as a torso instead of a sphere.
Replace the thin horizontal red slab with a flared, draped fauld/skirt that hangs below the belt and covers the gap to the legs.
Fix the legs/feet: close the visible gap between torso and thighs, attach the dark feet to the greaves, and give them a forward-pointing foot shape instead of floating boxes.
Enlarge the head/helmet relative to the body and add a readable face (cheek/jaw plane + mustache block) so the front view is not a two-dot bead.
Add the gold helmet crest ridge and brow trim the plume should attach to, and verify the gold chest straps read as a diagonal cross-strap rather than a random X of tubes.

versions.summary: Rebuilt as a recognizable medieval plate knight (~4.5u tall, feet on y=0, facing +Z, character-right=-X). KEY FIXES vs reference: (1) Plume is now ONE continuous curved tube sweep (7 world-space points) rising from the gold crest ridge, arcing backward (-Z) and down to the back/shoulder, with two small fatten ellipsoids along the same arc (no stacked vertical pills, no forward hook). (2) Both weapons are gripped: the right gauntlet fist (ellipsoid at -0.6,1.6,0.22) encloses the vertical wood spear shaft at mid-height, and the left gauntlet fist (0.5,1.55,0.3) encloses the leather sword grip, so neither floats. (3) Torso reshaped from a barrel: a tapered waist lathe + a flatter front breastplate box + shoulder yoke, with three hanging steel tasset plates and a clean two-tube gold diagonal cross-strap (X) on the front plane plus gold rivets. (4) The thin red slab is replaced by a flared, draped red fauld/skirt (flaring lathe + 8 radially-oriented vertical fold strips) hanging below the leather belt/gold buckle to cover the torso-to-leg gap. (5) Legs/feet fixed: thigh/knee/shin steel tubes now overlap the skirt, an ankle ellipsoid bridges each greave to a forward-pointing dark sabaton (foot box + toe cap) instead of floating boxes. (6) Head enlarged with a readable face: skin face plane, nose, two eyes, gold brow, two angled mustache blocks and a beard/jaw block, gold cheek guards, and a gold top crest ridge the plume attaches to. (7) Spear has a lathe steel head, crossguard, gold collar, hanging red flag, and dark butt; sword has pommel, leather grip, gold crossguard, tapered steel blade and tip. Seeded jitter (api.random()) perturbs a few small accents. 10 named objects, ~85 parts, all primitive types (renderer derives the 5 LODs); small details use lastLevel 1-3 to drop at lower LODs.

review.summary: The assembly reads as a steel-armored figure with red sleeves, red skirt, spear and sword, so the concept is present, but it diverges badly from the reference in the head, plume, hands and gear. Front view shows a featureless silver ball head with a tiny floating face patch, a red plume lump on top, bare-sphere shoulders, a flat untrimmed chest box, and hands that do not touch the spear. Side view exposes the plume as a solid candy-cane hook arching over the head (no crest, no sweep down the back), a flat slab torso, a table-like pink skirt disc, and ribbed tube legs. Back view confirms a flat red slab plume and a featureless box back. The spear's red ribbon floats detached in mid-air, and the sword is a thin stick with no guard. These are coherent-enough to keep working on, but several parts are malformed or unattached, so it is not yet a recognizable match at the requested detail.
issues: Reshape the plume: it currently renders as a thick solid hook/candy-cane (side) and a lump (front). Rebuild it as a flat, tapered crest that rises from a top-of-helmet crest and sweeps down behind the head, and add the gold crest band along its base that is visible in the reference.

The head is a bare silver sphere with no helmet. Add cheek guards, a face frame and a real face opening so the skin, eyes and mustache sit inside an opening instead of as a small floating patch on a ball.
Fix the face: the mustache is two disconnected angled boxes and the eyes are mispositioned; seat a single connected mustache at the lower opening and center both eyes within the face opening.
The hands are plain spheres and do not grip the spear; the spear floats beside the body. Add a closed-glove form wrapping the shaft at the right-hand height so the spear is visibly held.
The red spear ribbon is a detached rectangle floating in mid-air; attach it to the shaft just below the crossbar.
Shoulders are bare spheres; add overlapping steel pauldron plates, and add gold trim bands around the breastplate edges (the chest is currently a flat untrimmed box).
Replace the single gold X-cross on the chest with the reference's single diagonal baldric strap.
The sword is a thin gray stick with no guard; build a proper blade with crossguard, pommel and a belt seat at the left hip.
The skirt reads as a pink disc with thin red 'legs'; rebuild it as a pleated fauld (tapered form with vertical pleat ridges) and add a leather waist belt with a gold buckle.
Legs render as ribbed segmented tubes (radial-segmentation artifact) and the boots are flat boxes; smooth the leg forms into greaves with a knee cop and give the boots a foot shape.
Add the gold rim/band on the helmet brow and the gold side discs (ear/temple fittings) seen in the reference head.
